defect: An IPv6 route table listed once and then gone at its second open is read as a host without IPv6, so an ENI whose IPv6 default route the first listing showed resolves.

property.text: The IPv6 route text comes from two listings that agree, and the ENA function check refuses as unverifiable when no two listings agree.

evidence.gap: The simulated environment has no host procfs, sysfs, mount table, netlink route tables or kernel drivers, which every bind site reads or writes through `bind::Host`, and no simulation tree reaches a bind site: at 6240a6fd9, `rg -n 'crate::bind::' crates/kestrike/src/worker.rs crates/kestrike/src/sim crates/kestrike/src/net/world_tests crates/kestrike/src/net/takeover_history_tests crates/kestrike/src/oracle` lists only `bind::fixture::spawn_quiet`, a process fixture of the campaign fuzz tests. The code runs under the `kestrike-bind` binary and the bind module's own tests.
